up: Find the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL2163249' and retrieve all compounds that are associated with it via the compound_records table. For each compound, return the following fields: compound ChEMBL ID, compound name (pref_name from molecule_dictionary), maximum phase (max_phase), molecule type (molecule_type), and canonical SMILES. Order the results by compound ChEMBL ID in ascending order. Include all compounds, even if some fields are missing (use left joins where necessary).
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name AS compound_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2163249' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
